blocks.text: The Behaviour of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) with Beggars
Hadhrat Aflah bin Katheer says, "Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) never refused any beggar and even a leper with fingers dripping with blood could be seen eating with him from the same plate."
The Incident of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)

Hadhrat Hasan Basri reports that Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) once brought his Sadaqah to Rasulullaah ﷺ. He secretly gave it to Rasulullaah ﷺ saying, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! This is my Sadaqah contribution and I shall give again for Allaah whenever necessary." Thereafter, Hadhrat Umar (RA) arrived with his Sadaqah. He gave it openly to Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! Here is my Sadaqah contribution and I shall have my reward with Allaah." Rasulullaah ﷺ said, "O Umar! You have strung your bow without a string. The difference in the Sadaqah of you two is just like the difference in your words." (Although the Sadaqah of both men were accepted, the intention of Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA) was only the pleasure of Allaah, whereas that of Hadhrat Umar (RA) was also to attain reward. Hadhrat Abu Bakr (RA)'s intention was therefore superior.)[^1]
Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) Purchases the Well of Roomah and Donates it to the Muslim Public

Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) narrates that Rasulullaah ﷺ once announced, "Who will purchase the well of Roomah for us and donate it as Sadaqah for the Muslim public? Allaah will quench his thirst on the Day of Qiyaamah." Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA) then bought it and donated it to the Muslim public.[^2]
The Narration of Ibn Asaakir About the Incident

Hadhrat Basheer Aslami (RA) narrates that when the Muhaajireen arrived in Madinah, the water did not agree with them. There was a well called Roomah which was owned by a man from the Ghifaar tribe but he sold a waterbag full of the water for a Mudd. Rasulullaah ﷺ once said to him, "Sell me the well in exchange for a fountain in Jannah." However, he submitted, "O Rasulullaah ﷺ! I have no source of income for my family and myself besides this well. I am therefore unable to sell it." When this news reached Hadhrat Uthmaan (RA), he bought the well from the man for thirty five thousand Dirhams. He then approached Rasulullaah ﷺ and said, "Rasulullaah ﷺ!
